story.title: Nashville Airport to Be Renamed in Honor of Dolly Parton Following Governor's Proposal
story.summary: Tennessee Governor Bill Lee has announced a proposal to rename Nashville International Airport in honor of Dolly Parton. This initiative comes after a fan-led petition, which gained significant traction following Parton's recent death, garnered over 155,000 signatures. The proposal is set to be discussed at the Metro Nashville Airport Authority's meeting on September 17.

related_stories.title: Greenland to Establish Truth Commission on Forced Contraception Practices
related_stories.summary: Greenland's government announced the formation of a Truth and Reconciliation Commission to investigate a campaign of forced contraception conducted by Danish authorities from the 1960s to the 1990s. This decision follows two expert reports that could not reach a consensus on whether the actions constituted genocide. The campaign reportedly involved thousands of Indigenous women and girls receiving contraceptive devices or injections without their consent.

related_stories.title: Norway Mourns King Harald V as Crown Prince Haakon Ascends the Throne
related_stories.summary: Norway is in mourning following the death of King Harald V at the age of 89. Crowds gathered outside the Royal Palace in Oslo to pay tribute, joined by Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre and other officials. Crown Prince Haakon has now ascended the throne, adopting the family motto 'all for Norway.'

related_stories.title: Lawmakers and Canada Reject Trump's Renaming of Lake Ontario Amid Trade Tensions
related_stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario to 'Lake America'. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney responded by stating that the lake will continue to be called Lake Ontario, emphasizing that its name will remain unchanged. This order follows recent tensions between the U.S. and Canada, including the collapse of trade talks and the announcement of reciprocal tariffs.

related_stories.title: Trump Signs Executive Order to Rename Lake Ontario Amid Trade Dispute with Canada
related_stories.summary: President Trump has signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario as 'Lake America' in the United States. This move is part of escalating tensions in a trade dispute with Canada. The order directs federal agencies to implement the name change on U.S. maps and documents, although it does not affect the Canadian portion of the lake, which Canada has rejected.
